revision_summary:
Four timestamp/quote-span issues need correcting (all minor, quotes are real but mis-anchored): (1) state_changes[2] and multi_touch_patterns[0].touches[1] both cite the customer's 04:09 quote but the quoted text actually spans 04:09-04:44 — extend or split the ts range. (2) cherry_pick_moments[4] quotes a clause ('I guess what I have to have...') that actually lands closer to 04:27-04:44, not 04:09 — retime it. (3) script_coverage[4].roof.customer_quote attributes the sun-exposure line to ts 01:35, but that's when the REP says 'let me pull up the house' — the customer's actual sun-exposure quote is at 02:04. Fix the customer_quote ts to 02:04 or add a separate customer_ts field.

Additionally: (a) Reclassify the 'outcome_dispute' — Stage 3 agrees the DQ outcome is substantively correct, so this is not a genuine outcome dispute; it's an execution/process critique (no clean close). Move this content out of outcome_dispute framing and into trajectory_verdict summary or coaching_focus. (b) Fix schema misuse: 'dq_rules.roof_too_old_no_replacement' is cited as an analog for a shading-based DQ twice, but that rule is specifically about roof AGE, not tree shading — there is no shading-specific DQ rule in the schema. Flag this explicitly as a schema gap (TBD with Kenny) rather than presenting it as an existing analog. (c) Consider elevating the fully-skipped 'interest_in_solar' required Verify item (customer's only near-miss at 00:49, never probed) to coaching_focus, since a completely omitted hard-required beat is arguably higher priority than execution-quality issues on beats that were at least attempted. (d) Soften the certainty in rep_intent evidence at 02:46 and the rejected alternative_hypothesis at cherry_pick_moments[1] — both assert reactive-only readings with more confidence than the transcript supports; acknowledge the supervisor-consult could reflect a legitimate (if clumsy) escalation procedure rather than pure uncertainty.
